purpose: Settle the stage-294 ambiguity by removing the heuristic from the loop and making noise the controlled variable: the eps-tolerant minimum source count is a property of the model, computed exactly.
definition: Given observations d_r and a tolerance eps >= 0, the minimum number k of strict interior sources on distinct original edges, with weights p_i > 0 summing to one and a common mean pendant y > 0, such that |y + sum_i p_i dist_T(r, q_i) - d_r| <= eps for every observed r.

method.threshold_form: For a fixed support S, theta(S) = min over the CLOSED set {alpha, beta, y >= 0, sum = 1} of max_r |pred_r - d_r|, one exact rational LP.  Theta_k = min over all C(|E|, k) supports of size k. Theta_k is non-increasing in k and, for every eps > theta(S), the STRICT system on S is feasible (segment to any strictly feasible box point; the prediction is affine).  Hence the eps-tolerant minimum is m(eps) = min{k : Theta_k < eps} for eps > 0, and the whole eps axis is determined by the exact rational vector (Theta_1, Theta_2, ...) - no eps ladder is run, the ladder is a reporting choice applied afterwards.
method.m_at_zero: m(0) is decided separately because the closed LP admits degenerate configurations (zero endpoint mass, zero pendant): the smallest k for which some support with theta(S) = 0 is STRICTLY feasible, decided by a max-common-slack LP whose optimum must be > 0.
method.top_of_ladder: Theta_K = 0 for every leaf set, certified per job by verifying the generating witness on the retained observations with the frozen independent verifier, so sweeps stop at k = K - 1.
method.lp: Dense two-phase tableau simplex over Fractions written for this stage (stage296_common.lp_minimize), Dantzig pricing with a switch to Bland after 60 iterations.  Row generation over the 2|R| tolerance rows: the active-subset LP is a relaxation, so its value is an exact lower bound, which both certifies optimality when no leaf is violated and prunes exactly against the incumbent.
method.forbidden: The frozen structural localisation - leaf envelope h, weighted deficit bound, positive-anchor filters, solve_partial, stage292_all_minimisers, stage295_reduced_minimum - is derived from exact equality and is unsound under a tolerance.  It is used only in the eps = 0 validation phase.
method.verification: Every reported witness is re-evaluated on the ORIGINAL tree with the frozen min(d(r,u) + xL, d(r,v) + (1-x)L) form - an implementation independent of the interpolation the LP uses - and the recomputed max |pred - d| must equal theta exactly.

draw_plan.note: Identical draws to stage 288, so the eps = 0 column reproduces that stage.

within_eps_rule: Every incompleteness comparison is made against that case own full-panel answer AT THE SAME eps, never against the eps = 0 answer, so the noise-induced collapse and the incompleteness-induced collapse are not confounded.

scale_ceiling.cross_arm: k <= K - 1 <= 2 exhaustively; K in {2, 3} only.
scale_ceiling.reason: Exhaustive enumeration costs C(|E|, k) exact LPs at roughly 6 ms each; the frozen localisation that would avoid it is unsound under a tolerance.

analysis: Retain every job including timeouts and errors; never impute.  A comparison uses only (case, draw) pairs where both the draw and its own full-panel baseline completed.
limitations: Exactly explainable families only: a tolerance has no meaning without an exact reference answer to compare against.
The cross arm covers K in {2, 3}; K >= 5 is observed only through Theta_1, Theta_2 (and Theta_3, Theta_4 where the support budget allows) at the full panel.
eps is an L-infinity tolerance; a median residual is not the eps a dataset needs.
At the measure-zero coincidence eps == Theta_k > 0 the convention m(eps) = min{k : Theta_k < eps} is used, which is the conservative (larger-m) choice.
No claim about which support is recovered, and no claim about any estimator.
